landing.aboutDescription: Syncro is a transparent reverse auction marketplace designed to remove the friction of traditional hiring by letting people — instead of algorithms — determine fair market value. cakes.title: Artisanal Birthday, Wedding & Celebration Cakes
cakes.desc: From custom themed birthday cakes in Colombo to tiered wedding cake structures in Kandy, discover talented home bakers ready to craft delicious bespoke treats for your special day.

catering.title: Authentic Sri Lankan Feasts & Short Eats
catering.desc: Catering for family almsgivings, office lunches, or grand wedding receptions. Local caterers bring authentic Sri Lankan rice & curry spreads, spicy patties, fish cutlets, and savory rolls to your venue.
catering.sampleRequest: Traditional Lunch Buffet & Evening Short Eats for 80 Guests (Colombo)

bridal.title: Traditional Kandyan, Indian & Western Bridal Dressing
bridal.desc: Hire experienced bridal makeup artists, saree drapers, and hair stylists for your wedding or homecoming. Packages include trial sessions, bridal party dressing, and high-end jewelry styling.
bridal.sampleRequest: Full Bridal Dressing, Hair Styling & 3 Bridesmaids (Colombo / Gampaha)

florists.title: Fresh Tropical Bouquets & Wedding Arrangements
florists.desc: Boutique florists creating bespoke bridal bouquets, fresh orchid arrangements, vehicle decorations, and event stage backdrops delivered fresh to your doorstep.
florists.sampleRequest: Bridal Bouquet, Bridesmaid Bouquets & Car Décor (Negombo)

photography.title: Cinematic Wedding & Event Shoots Across Sri Lanka
photography.desc: Capture life’s memorable milestones. Hire professional photographers and drone videographers for weddings, pre-shoots in Ella or Nuwara Eliya, commercial product shoots, and family portraits.

webDev.title: Custom Web Apps, POS Systems & E-Commerce Stores
webDev.desc: Build your retail store website, hotel booking system, or custom inventory software. Talented local developers and tech agencies compete with clear milestones and safe payments.
webDev.sampleRequest: Hotel Room Booking Web App & Payment Gateway (Bentota / Galle)

tutors.title: O/L & A/L Exam Preparation & Skill Coaching
tutors.desc: Connect with experienced Sri Lankan teachers and university graduates for one-on-one home or online tutoring in Combined Maths, Physics, Chemistry, English, and Software Development.
tutors.sampleRequest: A/L Combined Mathematics Individual Tutoring — 2 Days/Week (Gampaha)

branding.title: Brand Identity, Packaging & Social Media Content
branding.desc: Get complete branding for your tea brand, restaurant, clothing line, or boutique. Sri Lankan creative designers compete with custom logos, packaging mockups, and social templates.
branding.sampleRequest: Complete Brand Identity, Product Labels & Social Media Kit (Colombo)

dualPerspective.oneAccountNote: Start as a client to post tasks. Create a verified business profile anytime to offer services and earn — all with one account.
dualPerspective.heading: Built for Clients & Service Providers
dualPerspective.sub: Whether you need to get work done quickly or want steady client work, Syncro puts you in control.
dualPerspective.buyerTitle: Get Quality Work Done Without Overpaying
dualPerspective.buyerDesc: Stop spending days calling different shops or sending messages into Facebook groups with no reply. Post your job for free and let skilled providers bid downwards to win your business.
dualPerspective.buyerBullet1: Post your task or project for 100% free
dualPerspective.buyerBullet2: Providers bid down to offer you their best price and timeline
dualPerspective.buyerBullet3: Review real ratings, portfolios, and message providers directly
dualPerspective.buyerBullet4: Your payment is held safely and only released when you approve the work
dualPerspective.sellerTitle: Find Real Clients & Grow Your Income
dualPerspective.sellerDesc: Access a live feed of genuine Sri Lankan clients actively looking for your exact skills. Bid directly, negotiate transparently, and get guaranteed payouts upon milestone delivery.
dualPerspective.sellerBullet1: Access instant lead feeds filtered by your industry and location
dualPerspective.sellerBullet2: Submit customized bids directly to clients ready to hire
dualPerspective.sellerBullet3: Build a verified public profile and showcase your portfolio
dualPerspective.sellerBullet4: Guaranteed payment protection — funds are locked before you begin work

howItWorks.title: How Syncro Works in 3 Easy Steps
howItWorks.desc: A reverse auction marketplace that saves clients money and connects service providers with high-paying work.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Describe your job or project in plain English. Our AI assistant can help structure your requirements, budget, and timeline in seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Relevant verified providers review your request and bid directly. Because providers compete to win your business, you get the best market rate.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Compare quotes, portfolios, and reviews. Choose the provider you like best. Funds are held safely by Syncro and only released when you are 100% satisfied with the work.

testimonials.title: Real Experiences Across Sri Lanka
testimonials.desc: See how clients and businesses are growing with Syncro.
testimonials.story1Quote: “I run a small boutique design studio in Colombo. Finding reliable clients used to cost us a lot in Facebook ads. With Syncro, we browse real client requests, submit bids, and won 5 new recurring clients in our first 45 days.”
testimonials.story2Quote: “We needed a custom booking and POS system for our hotel in Kandy. Traditional agencies quoted crazy prices. I posted on Syncro, received 4 competitive bids within 2 hours, and hired a skilled dev team that delivered it seamlessly.”

pricing.title: Zero Upfront Cost, Pay Only for Results
pricing.desc: No subscription fees, no bidding credits, no surprises.
pricing.tier1Desc: Clients can post unlimited project requests and receive bids for free.
pricing.tier2Desc: Low flat fee only deducted when a project is completed and paid.
pricing.tier3Desc: Funds stay safely locked in Syncro until you review and approve the finished work.
